protocol.scope: Prompt behavior/cost pilot, not held-out gameplay efficacy or calibration
protocol.selection: 8 per historical agree/override/tied/no-best stratum; SHA order; one per run/floor; <=2/run/stratum
protocol.baseline: Unique visible rank only; tied/missing ranks explicitly abstain; no new gameplay ranking
protocol.fresh_calls: All 3 API arms pinned to same model; historical latest answers are descriptive only
protocol.compact: Remove only intermediate realization traces and redundant equal dmg, retaining inputs/knowledge/limits
protocol.order: Reverse insertion order with option IDs stable; this does not test name/ID bias
protocol.repeat: Same-input repeats distinguish output variation from order-associated variation
protocol.uncertainty: Balanced diagnostic strata are not population weights; run/SL correlation remains
protocol.truth: No original simulator rank or Jev confidence is an outcome truth label
protocol.gates: No production change; original R3 learner must independently validate paired candidate outcomes first
protocol.language: English/Chinese narrow-question follow-up deferred; do not translate learned knowledge without fidelity check
